hypotheses.F1_same_as_state_query_components: Mean canonical cosine between the full-width and state-64 query-map top-four output subspaces is at least 0.75.
hypotheses.F2_same_as_natural_write_subspace: Mean canonical cosine between the full-width top four and empirical natural-write top four is at least 0.75.
hypotheses.F3_simple_output_roles: Every full-width outlier has best oriented token-predicate AUROC at least 0.70.
hypotheses.F4_low_rank_input_forms: For every outlier, four input eigenmodes contain at least 50% of exact interaction-form energy.
hypotheses.F5_top_modes_are_specific: For every outlier, top-mode edits cause at least four times the median absolute scalar effect of low-mode edits.
hypotheses.F6_top_modes_reach_behavior: For at least three outliers, top-mode edits cause at least four times the median final-logit KL of low-mode edits.
hypotheses.F7_weight_formula_predicts_edits: For every outlier, exact-form predictions correlate at least 0.99 with finite top-mode scalar effects.
